in_marathi.name: Lishitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lishitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Lakshmi is the embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. Lishitha is derived from the word Lakshmi, meaning the one who brings wealth and happiness.

in_bengali.name: Lishitha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lishitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Lakshmi is the embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. Lishitha is derived from the word Lakshmi, meaning the one who brings wealth and happiness.
